title: Player state
description: The copy of a player's state that the server writes and reads back: the `payload` column of a save (SAVE-1, SAVE-2, game.py:744-753) and the `snapshot` column of an account (ACCOUNT-6, game.py:373-383). A start of the server reads both, so a regenerated server must accept old rows of this shape. Recovered from the legacy code on 2026-11-25.

location.description: A location title. A start skips a save whose title no longer exists (SAVE-2).

bag.description: The item sids in the bag, in the order they were taken.

moves.description: The move count. Added to the payload in 2023 (game.py:754).

visited.description: The titles of the visited locations, sorted. GOLD-1 reads it.

opened.description: The sids of the items this player opened, sorted. GOLD-2 reads it.
